scope: Read-only SDK trace source/interfaces/workflow/tests/required docs plus four focused stdlib adversarial probes; no full test or chain execution.

findings.title: Accept the unprotected legacy signatures supported by the engine
findings.trigger: Read an engine trace containing a historical legacy transaction with v27/v28.
findings.evidence: _signed_metadata only allows37/38, while engine817 signed_transaction permits27/28/37/38. A canonical RLP legacy envelope with v27 is rejected by the SDK helper. Existing legacy fixture only covers protected signatures.
findings.expected: Align allowed legacy parity/chain semantics with engine817, retaining all scalar/shape checks.

findings.title: Bound total storage keys across access-list entries
findings.trigger: Canonical type1 RLP access list with8entries each containing33storage keys.
findings.evidence: 264 total keys are admitted by _signed_metadata, while engine capture supports at most256total keys. Per-entry<=256 does not enforce the aggregate limit.
findings.expected: Refuse aggregate access-list storage keys above256 as well as oversized individual lists.

findings.title: Bind receipt gas to the original signed transaction gas budget
findings.trigger: Reseal the actual one-prefix report after changing both original and baseline gasUsed/cumulativeGasUsed to30,000,000.
findings.evidence: The original raw typed envelope gas budget is297,348. verify_trace still returnsTrue and baseline_verified remainsTrue because _receipt compares only against the block gas limit; raw gas is decoded and discarded.
findings.expected: Return signed gas budget in metadata and require original/executed gasUsed<=that budget.

findings.title: Refuse reverted receipts retaining logs or contract creation output
findings.trigger: Reseal the actual one-prefix report after changing both original and baseline status to0x0 but retaining their8logs.
findings.evidence: verify_trace returnsTrue and baseline_verified remainsTrue for internally impossible projected receipts. Existing checks do not tie revert status to empty logs/null contractAddress, or non-null to to null contractAddress.
findings.expected: Enforce these known receipt relationships before accepting declared match flags.

probe_command: PYTHONPATH=src:../.worktrees/engine-agent-worker/src python3 heredoc; decode fixed public RLP vectors and reseal only in-memory copies of fixed public reports; no signature key, RPC or Anvil involved.
observations: Legacy v27 admitted=False; engine constructor permits v27/v28.
otherwise_reviewed: Frozen typed rows/receipts/logs and fresh serialized snapshots resist caller mutations.
Exact plan/source/prefix identities, baseline-derived shared nonce anchors and queued-not_mined counter policy are consistent.
Exact unique difference field sets tolerate object key ordering.
Regular-file/nonblocking8MiB loader and duplicate-key refusal remain offline; no trace HTTP path added.
limits: Canonical metadata probes are synthetic edits of existing public wire data, not newly signed or executed transactions.
No public/private chain access, upstream writes, model/holdout changes, Docker startup, installed-wheel build or full suite rerun.
No protected-main GitHub approval; review findings require owner fixes and focused re-review.
